narrative.overview: A blue masthead groups destinations above quiet working surfaces. Public Sans, compact controls, cool ground, and consistent borders keep configuration and execution evidence readable. Selection and operational state have distinct, labeled roles.
dos: Do reuse shared composition and semantic tokens.
Do preserve accessible labels, unique IDs and feedback.
Do keep main-agent ownership and explicit approvals legible.
donts: Don't turn selection or shared UI into a capability grant.
Don't expose decisions without their evidence.
Don't treat source tests as rendered verification.
